environment.description: Ktor 2.3.x microservice deployed on EKS (Kubernetes 1.28) behind an NLB (Layer 4). PgBouncer 1.21 in transaction pooling mode on port 6432 proxying to PostgreSQL 15. APP_MASTER_KEY is set via Kubernetes Secret mounted as environment variable. No additional API gateway or token validation middleware. Container runs as non-root with default seccomp profile. Network policy allows pod-to-pod communication within the namespace.
